source: Upstream README for sdli1995/dlssg_for_sm86 0.4.0. Entries are limited to games the upstream author reported running.

entries.name: Cyberpunk 2077
issues: A game whose Streamline frame-generation plugin is limited to 4× stays at 4×.
entries.notes: Upstream 0.4.0 reports 4× on RTX 3070. This is not a claim that every install or every mod version behaves the same.

entries.name: Black Myth: Wukong
issues: The rendering executable is under b1\Binaries\Win64, not the install root.
entries.notes: Upstream 0.4.0 reports 4×. The install manual uses this game as the nested Win64 example.

entries.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
entries.notes: Upstream 0.4.0 reports a DX12 run on RTX 3070. Next-gen DX12 is the relevant mode.

entries.name: Forza Horizon 6
entries.notes: Upstream 0.4.0 reports 4×. No store id is recorded here because the upstream note does not publish one.

entries.name: A Plague Tale: Resonance
entries.notes: Upstream 0.4.0 reports this title running 6× when frame generation is set to dynamic or automatic.
